entries.definition: a little
entries.example: There was a bit of drama today at the office.
entries.exampleTranslation: 今天办公室里发生了一些戏剧性的事情。

entries.definition: It smells a bit...
entries.example: He's a bit of a film fanatic.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他是个有点电影狂热分子。

entries.definition: an instance or situation of a particular kind
entries.example: Now it's just a case of getting them to subscribe.
entries.exampleTranslation: 现在只需让他们订阅即可。

entries.definition: A pair..., three or two...
entries.example: They need a couple of minutes still.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们还需要几分钟。

entries.definition: a limited amount or level of something
entries.example: There is a degree of irony in the story.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这个故事有一定程度的讽刺意味。

entries.definition: several, few, some
entries.definitionTranslation: 几个, 少数, 一些
entries.example: After a few drinks, she started to dance.
entries.exampleTranslation: 喝了几杯之后，她开始跳舞。

entries.definition: an additional one or amount
entries.example: It's a further reason to reconsider the project.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是重新考虑该项目的另一个原因。

entries.definition: an attempt at doing something
entries.example: Why don't you have a go?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你为什么不去尝试一下呢？

entries.definition: Quite, enough
entries.example: It took him a good six or seven years.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他花了整整六七年的时间。

entries.definition: many
entries.example: She means a great deal to me.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她对我来说意义重大。

entries.definition: A lot
entries.example: She means a great deal to me.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她对我来说意义重大。

entries.definition: a handful, a minority
entries.example: Only a handful of them were actually awake.
entries.exampleTranslation: 只有少数人真正醒着。

entries.definition: some, a little, a little, a little, a little
entries.definitionTranslation: 一些, 一点点, 一点儿, 稍微, 些许
entries.example: I like to work out a little before dinner.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我喜欢在晚饭前做一点运动。

entries.definition: to a great extent or with a large effect
entries.definitionTranslation: 在很大程度上；大有帮助
entries.example: A little bit of compassion can go a long way.
entries.exampleTranslation: 一点点同情心可以起到很大的作用。

entries.definition: A lot, very, very much
entries.example: They go camping a lot in the summer.
entries.exampleTranslation: 夏天他们经常去露营。

entries.definition: only the small amount or number stated
entries.example: She made a mere penny per shirt.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她每件衬衫只赚一便士。

entries.definition: many
entries.example: A number of concerns were raised.
entries.exampleTranslation: 人们提出了一些担忧。

entries.definition: a matter that depends mainly on something
entries.example: It's a question of trust.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是一个信任问题。

entries.definition: a series; a number; a set
entries.definitionTranslation: 一系列; 一些; 一套
entries.example: Eventually, a range of events changed that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 最终，一系列事件改变了这一点。

entries.definition:
n. single
[Internet] Single; single; single room?
entries.definitionTranslation:
n. 单一
[网络] 单可；单一的；单人间吗
entries.example: Not a single idea emerged from the meeting.
entries.exampleTranslation: 会议没有提出任何想法。

entries.definition: All kinds of..., all kinds of...
entries.example: And a variety of issues seemed to stall the process.
entries.exampleTranslation: 各种问题似乎阻碍了这一进程。

entries.definition: About to, about to, just about to; desire
entries.example: Things were about to change.
entries.exampleTranslation: 事情即将发生变化。

entries.definition: Of prime importance; before anything else; especially.
entries.example: It is above all what people care most about.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是人们最关心的事情。

entries.definition: if someone is accounted for, you know where they are and so do not worry that they are not where they should be
entries.definitionTranslation: 对…负有责任；对…做出解释；说明……的原因；导致；（比例）占
entries.example: They'll need to account for their actions.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们需要为自己的行为负责。

entries.definition: to do something because you have been given information, advice, or orders
entries.definitionTranslation:
按...行动, 作用于
[机] 作用于
entries.example: She never acted on that rage.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她从来没有表现出那种愤怒。

entries.definition: to make an amount or number greater by adding another amount or number
entries.example: It does nothing to add to the scenery.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它对风景没有任何增加。

entries.definition: to have enough time, money, or opportunity to do something
entries.example: It's something you can't afford to miss.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是您不容错过的事情。

entries.definition: after all
entries.example: He is only six years old, after all.
entries.exampleTranslation: 毕竟他才六岁。

entries.definition: To plan, to intend; to aim at…
entries.definitionTranslation: 计划，打算; 目标在于…
entries.example: They aim to complete the project by the spring.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们的目标是在春季之前完成该项目。

entries.definition: simple past and past participle of aim at
entries.definitionTranslation: Target at 的简单过去式和过去分词
entries.example: The study is aimed at exploring how people use it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该研究旨在探索人们如何使用它。

entries.definition: Very nearly; everything short of. Most often precedes a verb or adjective.
entries.example: She all but gave up when she saw her test score.
entries.exampleTranslation: 当她看到自己的考试成绩时，她几乎放弃了。

entries.definition: all over, everywhere, all over
entries.definitionTranslation: 全部结束, 到处, 浑身
entries.example: The news was all over the web.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这个消息传遍了网络。

entries.definition: good, smooth, good, correct
entries.definitionTranslation: 好, 顺利, 良好的, 正确的
entries.example: If it's all right I think I'll head off to bed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果没问题的话我想我就去睡觉了。

entries.definition: All kinds of things
entries.example: We have all sorts of time left.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们还有很多时间。

entries.definition: always
entries.example: I go there all the time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我经常去那里。

entries.definition: Completely, as much as possible; in full; to the end or full extent.
entries.definitionTranslation: 从远道, 自始至终, 一路上
entries.example: I'm with you all the way.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我一直与你同在。

entries.definition: too
entries.example: Why is this all too familiar?
entries.exampleTranslation: 为什么这一切太熟悉了？

entries.definition: to consider something when making a plan or calculation
entries.example: Even if you allow for inflation, the price increase still seems exhorbitant.
entries.exampleTranslation: 即使考虑到通货膨胀，物价上涨仍然显得过高。

entries.definition: with..., together with..., together with...
entries.example: Along with his dog, the cat slowly stopped eating.
entries.exampleTranslation: 猫和他的狗一起慢慢停止进食。

entries.definition: [Jing] equal to, equivalent to
entries.example: Unfortunately, the player never amounted to much.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不幸的是，这位球员从来没有取得多大成就。

entries.definition: (informal) Used at the end of a statement to insinuate that there is more information that can be inferred from the preceding.
entries.example: I like art and all that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我喜欢艺术等等。

entries.definition: etc.
entries.example: My parents arrived, then John, his wife, and so on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我的父母到了，然后是约翰和他的妻子，等等。

entries.definition: except...
entries.example: Are there any others, apart from him?
entries.exampleTranslation: 除了他还有其他人吗？

entries.definition: [Law] resort to...
entries.example: It appeals to younger learners.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它对年轻的学习者很有吸引力。

entries.definition: result
entries.example: He was tired and as a result not very aware.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他很累，因此意识不太清醒。

entries.definition: on the whole
entries.example: As a whole it's OK.
entries.exampleTranslation: 整体来说还是可以的。

entries.definition: as far as, until, as far as
entries.definitionTranslation: 远到, 直到, 至于
entries.example: What are you thinking, as far as feasibility on this?
entries.exampleTranslation: 就可行性而言，您认为如何？

entries.definition: In the manner described hereafter.
entries.example: The plan is as follows.
entries.exampleTranslation: 计划如下。

entries.definition: As for
entries.example: As for the promotion, there may be other options.
entries.exampleTranslation: 至于促销，可能还有其他选择。

entries.definition: Almost the same as, actually equal to...
entries.definitionTranslation: 和...几乎一样, 实际上等于...
entries.example: It's as good as gone.
entries.exampleTranslation: 就跟消失了一样好。

entries.definition: like
entries.example: They walked together as if no time had passed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们一起走着，仿佛时间没有过去。

entries.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see as, it, were.
entries.definitionTranslation: 可以说是, 似乎就是
entries.example: The party was a smash as it were.
entries.exampleTranslation: 聚会真是一场盛大的聚会。

entries.definition: if only...
entries.example: It makes no difference as long as it's done.
entries.exampleTranslation: 只要完成了就没有什么区别。

entries.definition: at... time, from... time, to... time, until...
entries.definitionTranslation: 在…时候,从…时候起,到…时候止,直到…
entries.example: It was completed as of June.
entries.exampleTranslation: 截至六月已完成。

entries.definition: In contrast to, rather than, instead of; particularly used in defining a concept by providing an example that does not fall inside the concept.
entries.definitionTranslation: 完全不同, 截然相反, 反对, 对照
entries.example: Better now, as opposed to what?
entries.exampleTranslation: 现在更好，而不是什么？

entries.definition: Just...just
entries.example: As soon as he can he will call you back.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他会尽快给您回电话。

entries.definition: In the role or manner of the thing mentioned.
entries.example: The film was not a horror as such.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这部电影本身并不是恐怖片。

entries.definition: as if, as if
entries.example: He smiled then, as though remembering a joke.
entries.exampleTranslation: 然后他笑了，仿佛想起了一个笑话。

entries.definition: According to, according to, in accordance with; regarding, as for, in terms of...
entries.definitionTranslation: 根据,按照,依照;关于,至于,就…而言
entries.example: There was some confusion as to its whereabouts.
entries.exampleTranslation: 关于它的下落有些混乱。

entries.definition: as usual
entries.example: As usual he left it until the last minute.
entries.exampleTranslation: 像往常一样，他把这件事留到了最后一刻。

entries.definition: also
entries.example: I like it as well.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我也喜欢它。

entries.definition: Also, again
entries.example: She jogs as well as swims.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她不仅会游泳，还会慢跑。

entries.definition: Still
entries.example: I'm not convinced as yet.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我还不太相信。

entries.definition: every time, at a certain time
entries.example: They went in two at a time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们一次进去两个。

entries.definition: Fundamentally, completely
entries.example: Do you have any kids at all?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你有孩子吗？

entries.definition: In the most favorable of conditions, especially in a situation that is otherwise negative.
entries.example: He's at best average.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他充其量只是平均水平。

entries.definition: at first
entries.example: Not at first, but just the other day there was one.
entries.exampleTranslation: 一开始没有，但就在前几天有一个。

entries.definition: finally
entries.example: At last we met over coffee last week.
entries.exampleTranslation: 上周我们终于在喝咖啡时见面了。

entries.definition:
at least
[French] at least
entries.example: Well, you could email me at least.
entries.exampleTranslation: 好吧，你至少可以给我发电子邮件。

entries.definition: immediately
entries.example: I did it at once.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我立刻就做了。

entries.definition: At the same time, once
entries.example: At one time I thought that too.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有一段时间我也这么想。

entries.definition: now, currently
entries.example: There's nothing to do at present.
entries.exampleTranslation: 目前无事可做。

entries.definition: in danger, in critical time
entries.example: There's no reason to put passers by at risk.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有理由让路人面临危险。

entries.definition: (finance) Paid for by an individual or group.
entries.definitionTranslation:
归...付费, 在损害...的情况下
[法] 归...付费
entries.example: They were laughing at the expense of the photo.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们以照片为代价大笑。

entries.definition: now
entries.example: They have a lot going on at the moment.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们现在有很多事情要做。

entries.definition: Synonym of from the jump
entries.example: It went well, but not at the outset.
entries.exampleTranslation: 进展顺利，但一开始就不顺利。

entries.definition: at the same time, but
entries.example: At the same time it may be worth it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 同时这可能是值得的。

entries.definition: at that time, at that time
entries.example: I was busy at the time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我当时很忙。

entries.definition: At the current time or the time that was just described.
entries.example: At this point there's no telling who might win.
entries.exampleTranslation: 目前还无法判断谁会获胜。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) On occasion, sometimes.
entries.example: It can be slightly frustrating at times.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有时可能会有点令人沮丧。

entries.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see at, work. At one's workplace.
entries.example: There were strange forces at work.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有一些奇怪的力量在起作用。

entries.definition: if a system backs up, or if it is backed up, it has slowed down or stopped working because there is too much of something for it to deal with
entries.definitionTranslation: 支持, 倒退, 给...装上背衬
entries.example: I have proof to back up my story.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我有证据支持我的故事。

entries.definition: supported by a person, group, or resource
entries.example: The group is backed by the drug trade.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该组织得到毒品贸易的支持。

entries.definition: [Total] Basic style
entries.example: Based on the reports, it seems it was an accident.
entries.exampleTranslation: 根据报道，这似乎是一次意外。

entries.definition: to be required or considered likely to do something
entries.example: They can't be expected to just sit there and wait.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不能指望他们只是坐在那里等待。

entries.definition: It's possible..., it's very likely...
entries.example: To be honest, I'm likely to forget.
entries.exampleTranslation: 说实话，我很可能会忘记。

entries.definition: remember
entries.example: It was designed bearing in mind environmental impact.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它的设计考虑到了对环境的影响。

entries.definition: to feel confident that a person or organization is good or reliable
entries.example: I don't believe in corporal punishment.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不相信体罚。

entries.definition: comparative form of well off: more well off
entries.definitionTranslation: 比较富裕; 情况好转
entries.example: You're better off without him.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有他你会过得更好。

entries.definition: to make the effort to do something
entries.example: He never bothered to reply.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他从来懒得回复。

entries.definition: (only with a bare infinitive) Indicates something which cannot be avoided.
entries.definitionTranslation: （仅适用于不定式）表示无法避免的事情。
entries.example: It's bound to be better next time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 下次一定会更好。

entries.definition: if a meeting or other event breaks up, or if you break it up, it ends and people leave
entries.definitionTranslation: 打碎, 破碎, 分裂, 分解, 驱散, 结束, 衰退, 衰落, 变坏
entries.example: They did keep in touch after they broke up.
entries.exampleTranslation: 分手后他们还保持联系。

entries.definition: to make something happen, especially to cause changes in a situation
entries.example: It was expected that he would bring about change.
entries.exampleTranslation: 人们期望他会带来改变。

entries.definition: to look after a child until he or she becomes an adult
entries.definitionTranslation: 教育, 培养, 提出, 停下, 呕出
entries.example: Did you manage to bring up the holiday pay?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你设法提高假期工资了吗？

entries.definition: But on the other hand
entries.example: I went over budget, but then I expected I would.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我超出了预算，但后来我预计我会的。

entries.definition: contrast with, compare with, on the contrary
entries.definitionTranslation: 对比起来, 与之相比, 相反地
entries.example: The weather was by contrast a pleasant surprise.
entries.exampleTranslation: 相比之下，天气却令人惊喜。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) To a considerably large extent, easily.
entries.example: The rise in unemployment was by far the highest.
entries.exampleTranslation: 失业率增幅是迄今为止最高的。

entries.definition: rely on
entries.example: It was possible to achieve by means of coercion.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是可以通过强制手段实现的。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Certainly not; definitely not; not at all.
entries.example: We have by no means concluded the matter.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们还没有得出结论。

entries.definition: The hour being what it is; the hour being so advanced; considering that it is so far in time already; now that so much time has elapsed; if not before, now at the latest.
entries.example: I thought they'd be here by now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我以为他们现在就到了。

entries.definition: By the time of..., as of
entries.example: By the time dinner started there were none left.
entries.exampleTranslation: 到晚餐开始时，已经没有剩下的了。

entries.definition: on the way, by the way
entries.example: By the way, what day is the wedding?
entries.exampleTranslation: 顺便问一下，婚礼是哪一天？

entries.definition: (idiomatic) (originally) By the authority or power of; (now) because of; on the grounds of; by reason of.
entries.definitionTranslation:
依靠, 由于
[法] 凭藉, 依靠, 由于...
entries.example: She won by virtue of her superior intellect.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她凭借自己超群的智慧赢得了胜利。

entries.definition:
through, as, for
[Scripture] as, for, through
entries.definitionTranslation:
经由, 作为, 为了
[经] 当作, 为了, 通过
entries.example: It was only by way of bribery that they managed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们只是通过贿赂的方式才得以成功。

entries.definition: to go somewhere and get someone or something in order to take them to another place
entries.definitionTranslation: 叫(某人)来, 要求, 为...叫喊, 为...叫
entries.example: Hard times call for tough measures.
entries.exampleTranslation: 困难时期需要采取强硬措施。

entries.definition: to ask someone to prove a statement they have made
entries.definitionTranslation: 号召, 呼吁, 约请, 访问
entries.example: He called on his members of staff for advice.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他向他的工作人员寻求建议。

entries.definition: to be able to know or recognize something
entries.example: You can tell from the markings.
entries.exampleTranslation: 从标记上就可以看出。

entries.definition: to do the necessary things for someone who needs help or protection
entries.definitionTranslation: 喜欢, 照顾, 为...操心, 尊重
entries.example: He doesn't care for it very much in his tea.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他不太喜欢喝茶。

entries.definition: used to ask whether someone would like to do something
entries.example: Do you care to comment at all?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你愿意发表评论吗？

entries.definition: if two people are carrying on, they are having a sexual relationship that you do not approve of
entries.definitionTranslation:
继续开展, 行为愚蠢(或越轨)
[经] 继续发展(经营)下去
entries.example: He could simply not carry on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他根本无法继续下去。

entries.definition: to do a particular piece of work, research etc
entries.definitionTranslation:
进行, 实现, 贯彻, 执行
[经] 进行(到底), 执行, 落实
entries.example: It was not as easy to carry out without funding.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果没有资金，这项工作并不容易实施。

entries.definition: it's a phrase that means you should fill me in, you say it when you're missing out on something and you want to be filled in
entries.definitionTranslation:
把...很快拾起, 把...缠住
[计] 抓取程序
entries.example: I took extra classes just to catch up.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我参加了额外的课程只是为了赶上。

entries.definition: Like, rather, determined...
entries.example: You may choose to believe what the papers say.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你可以选择相信报纸上所说的。

entries.definition: if a ship comes about, it changes direction
entries.example: It all came about through a meeting back in April.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这一切都是在四月份的一次会议上发生的。

entries.definition: if someone or something comes across in a particular way, you have a particular opinion of them when you meet them or see them
entries.example: They happened to come across a map.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们碰巧发现了一张地图。

entries.definition: to become fashionable again
entries.definitionTranslation: 回来, 在记忆中重现, 复辟, 恢复, 回签
entries.example: But we can come back to that later.
entries.exampleTranslation: 但我们可以稍后再回来讨论这个问题。

entries.definition: if an illness comes on, it starts to affect you
entries.definitionTranslation: 偶遇, 进步, 发生, 开始, 出场, 快来
entries.example: Come on, think about it!
entries.exampleTranslation: 来吧，想想吧！

entries.definition: if a flower comes out, it opens
entries.definitionTranslation: 到边远地区来, 出现, 露出, 出版, 罢工, 结果是, 褪去, 被解出, 宣布
entries.example: It's supposed to come out on Friday.
entries.exampleTranslation: 应该会在周五发布。

entries.definition: if something comes to you, you think of it or remember it
entries.definitionTranslation: 谈到, 被...继承, 苏醒, 停止
entries.example: We came to see it for what it was.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们来看看它到底是什么。

entries.definition: (transitive) To resolve a conflict with.
entries.example: They were finally able to come to terms with the change in weather.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们终于能够接受天气的变化。

entries.definition: to be as good as you want, need, or expect something to be
entries.example: Men always come up to me first.
entries.exampleTranslation: 男人总是先来找我。

entries.definition: to produce or provide something that people want
entries.example: Is that the best you could come up with?
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是你能想到的最好的办法吗？

entries.definition: See Common sense, under Sense.
entries.example: To me it's common sense.
entries.exampleTranslation: 对我来说这是常识。

entries.definition: related to or dealing with a particular subject
entries.example: They spoke on issues concerned with culture.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们谈到了与文化有关的问题。

entries.definition: Composed of
entries.example: What does it consist of?
entries.exampleTranslation: 它由什么组成？

entries.definition: Coexisting with something [consistent]
entries.example: The results are consistent with our hypothesis.
entries.exampleTranslation: 结果与我们的假设一致。

entries.definition: Opposite of
entries.example: The city is clean, contrary to popular belief.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这座城市很干净，与普遍的看法相反。

entries.definition: was almost unable to do something
entries.example: I could hardly wait for the weekend.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我已经等不及周末了。

entries.definition: adv. every day
entries.example: They carried on with their day to day tasks.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们继续执行日常任务。

entries.definition: to accept and control a difficult emotional situation so that you can start to live a normal life again despite it
entries.definitionTranslation: 安排, 处理, 涉及, 做生意
entries.example: The police had several issues to deal with.
entries.exampleTranslation: 警方有几个问题需要处理。

entries.definition: to perform the action just mentioned
entries.example: Unfortunately, doing so also meant facing traffic.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不幸的是，这样做也意味着面临交通堵塞。

entries.definition: due to, due to
entries.example: Many people believe it is due to global warming.
entries.exampleTranslation: 许多人认为这是由于全球变暖造成的。

entries.definition: each other
entries.example: The good thing is that they still have each other.
entries.exampleTranslation: 庆幸的是，他们还拥有彼此。

entries.definition: to be in a particular place or state after doing something or because of doing it
entries.example: We ended up going anyway.
entries.exampleTranslation: 无论如何我们最终还是去了。

entries.definition: having the right to receive or do something
entries.example: You're entitled to your opinion.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你有权发表你的意见。

entries.definition: Even so
entries.example: Even so, it's no way to treat a guest.
entries.exampleTranslation: 即便如此，这也不是待客之道。

entries.definition: Although, despite
entries.example: I can't even though it looks easy enough.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不能，尽管它看起来很容易。

entries.definition: (duration) Continuously since a specified time or event.
entries.example: And they haven't been the same ever since.
entries.exampleTranslation: 从那以后他们就不再一样了。

entries.definition: [total] except
entries.example: It seemed fine except that it was pink.
entries.exampleTranslation: 看起来还不错，只是它是粉红色的。

entries.definition: face
entries.example: Faced with defeat, he changed tactics.
entries.exampleTranslation: 面对失败，他改变了策略。

entries.definition: failed to…
entries.example: I fail to see the humor in all this.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我看不出这一切有什么幽默之处。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) To have a desire for something, or to do something.
entries.definitionTranslation: 摸起来像是…, 有…的感觉; 想要…
entries.example: I feel like eating out.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我感觉很想出去吃饭。

entries.definition: same as fill
entries.definitionTranslation: 填充, 填写, 填满, 替代
entries.example: The victim filled in what was stolen.
entries.exampleTranslation: 受害人填写了被盗的物品。

entries.definition: Discover your situation, discover what you can do, feel about yourself
entries.definitionTranslation: 发觉自己的处境, 发现自己能做的事, 自我感觉
entries.example: I found myself driving home.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我发现自己开车回家。

entries.definition: to discover a fact or piece of information
entries.definitionTranslation: 找出, 发现, 想出, 揭发
entries.example: How did you find out?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你是怎么发现的？

entries.definition: first
entries.example: It is first of all what most people prefer.
entries.exampleTranslation: 首先，这是大多数人所喜欢的。

entries.definition: concentrate
entries.definitionTranslation: 致力于; 使聚焦于; 对（某事或做某事）予以注意; 把…作为兴趣中心
entries.example: But today I'd like to focus on something different.
entries.exampleTranslation: 但今天我想关注一些不同的事情。

entries.definition: to check the health of someone who has received medical treatment, in order to be certain that it was effective
entries.definitionTranslation:
穷追, 把...探究到底
[法] 追查, 追问, 追究
entries.example: I'd like to follow up on what that gentleman said.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我想跟进这位先生所说的话。

entries.definition: then, subsequently; sequel
entries.example: The workshop will be followed by time for questions.
entries.exampleTranslation: 研讨会结束后将有提问时间。

entries.definition: favorite
entries.example: I'm not very fond of it, to be honest.
entries.exampleTranslation: 老实说，我不太喜欢它。

entries.definition: although
entries.example: For all his money, he does not seem very happy.
entries.exampleTranslation: 尽管他有那么多钱，但他似乎并不高兴。

entries.definition: permanently, forever, once and for all
entries.definitionTranslation: 永久地, 永远地, 一劳永逸地
entries.example: It's gone for good.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它永远消失了。

entries.definition:
For example
[Law] For example
entries.example: That holds true for even the governor for instance.
entries.exampleTranslation: 例如，即使对于州长来说也是如此。

entries.definition:
Lifelong, to save one's life, to escape one's life
[French] lifelong
entries.definitionTranslation:
终身, 为了保命, 为逃命
[法] 终身
entries.example: And he stayed there for life.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他在那里度过了一生。

entries.definition: long
entries.example: He did attend university, but not for long.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他确实上过大学，但时间不长。

entries.definition:
for sale
[by] for sale, for sale
entries.definitionTranslation:
待售
[经] 出售, 待售
entries.example: The house is for sale.
entries.exampleTranslation: 房子正在出售。

entries.definition: For somewhat of a long time.
entries.example: He's actually been studying for some time now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他实际上已经学习了一段时间了。

entries.definition: temporarily, currently
entries.example: For the moment things seem stable.
entries.exampleTranslation: 目前看来一切都很稳定。

entries.definition: Because of; out of consideration for; in the interest of.
entries.definitionTranslation: 为...缘故, 为...起见, 为了某人, 为...目的, 为了...的利益
entries.example: He exaggerated his points for the sake of effect.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他为了效果夸大了自己的观点。

entries.definition: discovered or shown to have a particular quality
entries.example: It was found to be of little use in battle.
entries.exampleTranslation: 人们发现它在战斗中几乎没有什么用处。

entries.definition: To lift, without...
entries.example: I dream of a life free from stress.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我梦想没有压力的生活。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Occasionally; sometimes; once in a while.
entries.example: He does come round from time to time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他确实时不时地过来。

entries.definition: The full number of hours usually worked in a day or week, in distinction to part-time work.
entries.definitionTranslation: 专职,全部工作时间的,全日制
entries.example: I'm a full time fan of his music.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我是他音乐的忠实粉丝。

entries.definition: to escape from a person or place
entries.definitionTranslation: 离开, 逃脱, 起跑, 出发
entries.example: They managed to get away.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们设法逃脱了。

entries.definition: to manage to do something bad without being punished or criticized for it
entries.definitionTranslation: na. 拿走；避开责备[惩罚]；〈俚〉卷(款)潜逃；吃掉，喝掉
entries.example: Somehow they managed to get away with it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不知怎的，他们设法逃脱了惩罚。

entries.definition: if you get your money back, the money that you paid for something is given back to you
entries.definitionTranslation: 回来, 恢复, 送回, 重新上台
entries.example: What time will we get back?
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们什么时候回来？

entries.definition: if a train, plane etc gets into a place, it arrives there
entries.definitionTranslation: 进入, 陷入, 穿上
entries.example: I really got into what he was talking about.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我真的很了解他在说什么。

entries.definition: to borrow or take something from someone
entries.definitionTranslation: 下来, 脱下, 出发, 动身, 开始, 被容忍
entries.example: We waited for hours in the queue to get on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们在队列中等了几个小时才上车。

entries.definition: almost a particular time, number, age etc
entries.definitionTranslation: 生活, 融洽相处, 进展, 穿上, 上去, 使前进
entries.example: We waited for hours in the queue to get on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们在队列中等了几个小时才上车。

entries.definition: same as get along
entries.definitionTranslation: 继续（干某事）; 和…友好相处
entries.example: I need to get on with my work.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我需要继续我的工作。

entries.definition: if something secret gets out, a lot of people find out about it
entries.definitionTranslation: 出去, 离开, 逃脱, 摆脱, 泄露, 说出, 出版, 弄出来
entries.example: There was no way to get out of work that Friday.
entries.exampleTranslation: 那个星期五根本没法下班。

entries.definition: to annoy or upset someone
entries.definitionTranslation: 到达, 接触到, 开始, 对...有影响
entries.example: When he got to the end he started to weep.
entries.exampleTranslation: 当他读到最后时，他开始哭泣。

entries.definition: if the wind gets up, it starts blowing strongly
entries.example: It was easy getting up but the commute was awful.
entries.exampleTranslation: 起床很容易，但通勤很糟糕。

entries.definition: cause, cause to happen
entries.example: The protests gave rise to new violence.
entries.exampleTranslation: 抗议活动引发了新的暴力事件。

entries.definition: if you give something up as lost, you believe that you will not find it and you stop looking for it
entries.definitionTranslation:
放弃, 停止, 献出, 抛弃, 认输, 把...送交
[法] 放弃, 停止, 把...送交
entries.example: You can't just give up.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你不能就这样放弃。

entries.definition: take into account; assume; know
entries.definitionTranslation: 考虑到; 假定; 已知
entries.example: It was no surprise given that it was her job.
entries.exampleTranslation: 考虑到这是她的工作，这并不奇怪。

entries.definition: to go to a place before someone else who you are with
entries.example: Why don't you go ahead and call him again?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你为什么不继续再给他打电话呢？

entries.definition: to leave your home for a period of time, especially for a holiday
entries.example: The problem won't just go away.
entries.exampleTranslation: 问题不会就这样消失。

entries.definition: if two people go back a particular period of time, they have known each other for that period of time
entries.example: If I could I'd go back and do it all over again.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果可以的话我会回去重新做一遍。

entries.definition: if a person or thing has something going for them, they have an advantage, skill, or other positive quality
entries.definitionTranslation: 去找, 努力获取, 被认为, 主张, 拥护
entries.example: I could really go for a hamburger right now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我现在真的可以去吃汉堡了。

entries.definition: if a smaller number goes into a larger number, the larger number can be divided by the smaller a particular number of times
entries.definitionTranslation:
进入, 加入, 探究, 变得, 进入...状态
[法] 调查, 探讨, 进入
entries.example: I won't go into what he said.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不会深究他说的话。

entries.definition: if food or drink goes off, it is no longer fresh
entries.definitionTranslation: 离开, 去世, 消失, 爆炸, 被发射, 变质, 进行, 睡去, 卖掉
entries.example: She went off without even saying goodbye.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她连再见都没有说就走了。

entries.definition: almost a particular age, time, or amount
entries.definitionTranslation:
继续下去, 过去, 发生, 进行, 接近, (演员)上, (运动员)上场, 依靠, 依据, 责骂
[电] 继续
entries.example: He went on for a while before stopping for lunch.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他继续走了一会儿，然后停下来吃午饭。

entries.definition: to be broadcast on the radio or television
entries.definitionTranslation: 出去, 熄灭, 过时, 辞职, 倒塌, 罢工
entries.example: Brochures went out to prospective buyers.
entries.exampleTranslation: 宣传册已发给潜在买家。

entries.definition: if something such as an illness or a piece of news is going around, people are giving or telling it to each other
entries.definitionTranslation: 到处走动, 顺便去, 流传
entries.example: I'll go round asking if anyone wants any more.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我会四处询问是否有人想要更多。

entries.definition: if a law goes through, or if it goes through a law-making institution, it is officially approved
entries.definitionTranslation: 经历, 经受, 仔细检查, 搜查, 参加, 履行, 被通过, 用完
entries.example: You can't imagine what I'm going through.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你无法想象我正在经历什么。

entries.definition: will
entries.example: I'm going to think about it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我要考虑一下。

entries.definition: Good at…
entries.example: You need to find something you're good at.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你需要找到你擅长的事情。

entries.definition: The character >, denoting having a larger amount or number
entries.example: Anything greater than five is fine.
entries.exampleTranslation: 任何大于五的都可以。

entries.definition: (idiomatic, with bare infinitive, informal) Should; ought to; need to; must.
entries.example: They had better listen.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们最好听听。

entries.definition: thirty minutes after a stated hour
entries.example: I make it half past.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我做到了半点。

entries.definition: to give power or control to someone else
entries.example: The responsibility was expected to be handed over.
entries.exampleTranslation: 预计责任将被移交。

entries.definition: to continue doing something and achieve success even though there are difficulties
entries.definitionTranslation: 坚持, 不挂断, 靠着, 渴望, 有赖于
entries.example: If you can hang on for just a second.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果你能坚持一秒钟。

entries.definition: if something happens to you, an event or action takes place which affects you
entries.example: This happens to be my first conference.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这恰好是我的第一次会议。

entries.definition: (+ at) To examine, to observe.
entries.example: Why don't you have a look?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你为什么不看看呢？

entries.definition: have
entries.example: I don't know what he has got planned.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不知道他有什么计划。

entries.definition: Must; have to; must
entries.definitionTranslation: 必须; 不得不; 非得
entries.example: You have got to try this salad.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你一定要尝尝这个沙拉。

entries.definition: Have to, have to; have to; must; have no choice but to
entries.definitionTranslation: 不得不, 只好; 只得; 必须; 不得已
entries.example: I exercise because I have to.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我锻炼是因为我必须这样做。

entries.definition: to go in the direction of a place
entries.example: Meanwhile, he decided to head to the hospital.
entries.exampleTranslation: 与此同时，他决定前往医院。

entries.definition: simple past and past participle of hear of
entries.example: Haven't you ever heard of manners?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你没听说过礼仪吗？

entries.definition: formally believed, decided, or stated that
entries.example: The congress held that it was acceptable.
entries.exampleTranslation: 大会认为可以接受。

entries.definition: to cause a delay for someone or something, or to make them late
entries.definitionTranslation:
举起, 支撑, 继续下去, 阻挡, 拦截
[法] 支撑, 继续下去, 阻塞
entries.example: Sorry we got held up on the M25.
entries.exampleTranslation: 抱歉，我们在 M25 路上耽搁了。

entries.definition: Synonym of what about.
entries.example: How about tomorrow?
entries.exampleTranslation: 明天怎么样？

entries.definition: I mean; I mean
entries.example: It's fine, but, I mean, is it worth the price?
entries.exampleTranslation: 很好，但是我的意思是，值这个价钱吗？

entries.definition: used politely to introduce unwelcome information
entries.example: It hasn't arrived, I'm afraid.
entries.exampleTranslation: 恐怕还没到。

entries.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see if, only.
entries.example: If only I'd known sooner.
entries.exampleTranslation: 要是我早点知道就好了。

entries.definition: If so
entries.example: If so, you may want to consider Greece.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果是这样，您可能需要考虑希腊。

entries.definition: If you want, if you want to understand it this way, if you don't want anything else
entries.definitionTranslation: 如果你愿意, 如果你愿意这样理解, 如果你不想要别的
entries.example: It was her chutzpah? if you like that impressed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是她的放肆吗？如果你喜欢那印象深刻的话。

entries.definition: can
entries.example: I'm not in a position to comment right now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我现在无法发表评论。

entries.definition: In one sense or interpretation, but not in all ways.
entries.example: The food was in a sense only part of the experience.
entries.exampleTranslation: 从某种意义上说，食物只是体验的一部分。

entries.definition: To a certain degree; to an extent; in a certain sense.
entries.definitionTranslation: 在某种程度上, 稍稍
entries.example: It's funny in a way.
entries.exampleTranslation: 从某种程度上来说这很有趣。

entries.definition: According to: following the rules or standards of; in a way consistent with; in a way not discordant with.
entries.example: The plan was execute in accordance with municipal guidelines.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该计划是根据市政府指导方针执行的。

entries.definition: Except
entries.example: The house was well located in addition.
entries.exampleTranslation: 此外，房子位置也很好。

entries.definition: Beforehand.
entries.example: It's something you should do in advance.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是你应该提前做的事情。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Whatever be the case.
entries.example: It's not due till tomorrow in any case.
entries.exampleTranslation: 无论如何，它要到明天才到期。

entries.definition: To allow for the possibility that.
entries.example: In case you're wondering, this isn't my natural color.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果您想知道，这不是我的自然颜色。

entries.definition: Having the responsibility of leading or overseeing.
entries.definitionTranslation: 主管, 看管, 在...看管下
entries.example: He was able to stay in charge while she was away.
entries.exampleTranslation: 当她不在时，他能够继续负责。

entries.definition: Shared with one or more others.
entries.example: What they have in common is their stamina.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们的共同点是他们的耐力。

entries.definition: in conjunction with
entries.example: The police, in conjunction with the fire department, managed to keep the crowd under control.
entries.exampleTranslation: 警方与消防部门合作，成功控制了人群。

entries.definition: As opposed to.
entries.example: The inside was amazing in contrast.
entries.exampleTranslation: 相比之下，内部令人惊叹。

entries.definition: in detail
entries.example: I can explain in detail.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我可以详细解释一下。

entries.definition: Operating or functioning; in force; in play.
entries.definitionTranslation:
有效
[法] 有效, 生效, 实际上
entries.example: In effect it was like being in space.
entries.exampleTranslation: 实际上，这就像在太空中一样。

entries.definition:
in fact
[French] In fact
entries.example: The researchers tried several approaches, in fact.
entries.exampleTranslation: 事实上，研究人员尝试了几种方法。

entries.definition: Agree
entries.example: I don't know about you but I'm in favour.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不了解你，但我赞成。

entries.definition: in front of
entries.example: She did not want to say anything in front of the kids.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她不想在孩子们面前说什么。

entries.definition: Fully; to the whole extent.
entries.definitionTranslation:
充足, 以全文
[经] 全额
entries.example: She paid in full.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她全额付款。

entries.definition:
at hand, in progress, grasp
[French] being processed, under control
entries.definitionTranslation:
在手头, 在进行中, 掌握住
[法] 处理中, 受到控制
entries.example: It was well in hand by then.
entries.exampleTranslation: 那时它已经很好地掌握了。

entries.definition: Inherently; viewed independently, without reference to anything else.
entries.example: The car in itself wasn't enough incentive.
entries.exampleTranslation: 汽车本身并没有足够的激励作用。

entries.definition: conform to
entries.example: The decision is in line with the department's wishes.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这一决定符合部门的意愿。

entries.definition: Present in one's thoughts.
entries.definitionTranslation: 存在于一个人的思想中。
entries.example: Do you have anything special in mind?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你有什么特别的想法吗？

entries.definition: In times of urgent need, in times of poverty, in times of crisis
entries.definitionTranslation: 在急需时,在贫困时,在危难中
entries.example: We want to help children in need.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们想帮助有需要的孩子。

entries.definition: As a consequence of one's own skill, qualification or status, rather than that of another.
entries.example: Gesture is a form of expression in its own right.
entries.exampleTranslation: 手势本身就是一种表达形式。

entries.definition: for…
entries.example: We shared a room in order to reduce costs
entries.exampleTranslation: 为了降低成本，我们共用一个房间

entries.definition: in other words
entries.example: The groups are in other words conservative.
entries.exampleTranslation: 换句话说，这些团体是保守的。

entries.definition: To an extent; not fully.
entries.example: It is in part the reason people come here.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这也是人们来到这里的部分原因。

entries.definition: special
entries.example: There's nothing in particular wrong with it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有什么特别不妥的地方。

entries.definition: In an original position.
entries.definitionTranslation: 在适当的位置, 适当
entries.example: There are systems in place to handle that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有适当的系统来处理这个问题。

entries.definition: in practice, actually, skillfully
entries.definitionTranslation: 在实践中, 实际上, 熟练
entries.example: There was nothing she could do in practice.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在实践中她无能为力。

entries.definition: In principle, generally
entries.example: You can in principle.
entries.exampleTranslation: 原则上可以。

entries.definition: Under consideration, under discussion.
entries.definitionTranslation:
正被讨论, 可怀疑
[法] 正被谈论的, 成问题的, 被争论
entries.example: The book in question was published last year.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这本书是去年出版的。

entries.definition: [Law] Regarding, in terms of...
entries.example: There was nothing in respect of drink.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有什么关于喝酒的事情。

entries.definition: In return for...
entries.example: In return I'd like to present you with this gift.
entries.exampleTranslation: 作为回报，我想向您赠送这份礼物。

entries.definition:
In short
[Law] In short
entries.definitionTranslation:
简而言之
[法] 简言之
entries.example: The employees were in short tired of it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 简而言之，员工们对此感到厌倦。

entries.definition: Alternative spelling of insofar as.
entries.example: The plan was fine in so far as time and transport.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这个计划在时间和交通方面都很好。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Despite, irrespective of, notwithstanding.
entries.example: In spite of all the work there were few alterations.
entries.exampleTranslation: 尽管进行了所有工作，但几乎没有进行任何改动。

entries.definition:
Use..., according to, in accordance with, in terms of...
[French] use... words, word..., follow
entries.definitionTranslation:
用...的话, 根据, 按照, 在...方面
[法] 用...话, 以...措词, 按照
entries.example: What is your limit, in terms of price?
entries.exampleTranslation: 就价格而言，你的极限是多少？

entries.definition: Since, because
entries.example: It's great in that there are so many restaurants.
entries.exampleTranslation: 很棒的是有这么多餐馆。

entries.definition: when there is no..., when there is lack of...
entries.example: In the absence of truth, there is only conjecture.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在没有真相的情况下，只有猜测。

entries.definition:
during
[French] In the process of..., during...
entries.definitionTranslation:
在...期间
[法] 在...过程中, 在...期间
entries.example: In the course of the discussion the manager left.
entries.exampleTranslation: 讨论过程中，经理离开了。

entries.definition: finally, finally
entries.example: In the end it's like what they say about horses.
entries.exampleTranslation: 最后就像他们所说的马一样。

entries.definition:
if... happens
[French] If... happens
entries.definitionTranslation:
如果...发生
[法] 如果...发生
entries.example: In the event you change your mind, let me know.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果您改变主意，请告诉我。

entries.definition: face
entries.example: They quit in the face of the media scrutiny.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们在媒体的监督下退出了。

entries.definition: (sequence, idiomatic) To begin with; earlier; firstly; originally; at the start.
entries.example: He couldn't see how it got there in the first place.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他一开始就不明白它是怎么到那里的。

entries.definition: for, for the benefit of
entries.example: They stopped in the interest of time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们为了节省时间而停了下来。

entries.definition: In the illumination from (a source of light).
entries.definitionTranslation:
由于, 当作
[法] 根据, 按照
entries.example: In the light of the results, we delayed the study.
entries.exampleTranslation: 根据结果​​，我们推迟了研究。

entries.definition: during this period
entries.example: I'll keep working on it in the meantime.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在此期间我将继续努力。

entries.definition: Likewise
entries.example: In the same way, Apple appeals to the young.
entries.exampleTranslation: 同样，苹果对年轻人也很有吸引力。

entries.definition: block the way
entries.example: I won't stand in the way.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不会挡路。

entries.definition: Theoretically
entries.example: In theory that is why he went there.
entries.exampleTranslation: 理论上这就是他去那里的原因。

entries.definition: in this regard
entries.example: In this respect, our study refutes earlier research.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在这方面，我们的研究驳斥了早期的研究。

entries.definition:
timely
[French] on schedule, on schedule, timely
entries.definitionTranslation:
及时
[法] 如期, 按期, 及时
entries.example: You will in time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 到时候你就会的。

entries.definition: Stay in touch with
entries.example: Are you two at all in touch?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你们两个还有联系吗？

entries.definition: in turn, in turn
entries.example: The supermarket in turn will donate seven thousand.
entries.exampleTranslation: 超市也将捐出七千块。

entries.definition:
considering, due to
[Law] in view of
entries.definitionTranslation:
考虑到, 由于
[法] 鉴于
entries.example: She reconsidered in view of her children.
entries.exampleTranslation: 考虑到孩子的情况，她重新考虑了。

entries.definition: if that situation is true
entries.example: That means it's midnight, in which case it's closed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这意味着现在是午夜，在这种情况下它已经关闭。

entries.definition: In lieu of; in place of; rather than.
entries.example: He can go instead of me.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他可以代替我去。

entries.definition: is scheduled, expected, or required to
entries.example: Obama is to address the media this afternoon.
entries.exampleTranslation: 奥巴马将于今天下午向媒体发表讲话。

entries.definition: it requires a particular amount, effort, or quality
entries.example: No matter what it takes.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不管需要什么。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Approximately, very nearly.
entries.example: Am I finished? Just about.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我说完了吗？大约。

entries.definition: Just like
entries.example: I saw him just as he left.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他刚走我就看见了他。

entries.definition: to continue doing something
entries.example: Freeways kept on being built.
entries.exampleTranslation: 高速公路继续修建。

entries.definition: to continue to do something
entries.definitionTranslation:
不低落, 维持, 继续
[经] 坚持, 保持, 继续
entries.example: Keep up if you can.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果可以的话请继续。

entries.definition: to change something so that it is suitable for a particular purpose
entries.definitionTranslation: 改变某事物以使其适合特定目的
entries.example: Her input was key to the project's success.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她的意见是该项目成功的关键。

entries.definition: <mouth> a little, a little, somewhat
entries.definitionTranslation: <口>稍微, 有点儿, 有几分
entries.example: The windows are kind of fogged up.
entries.exampleTranslation: 窗户有点雾气。

entries.definition: recognized or reported as having a quality or habit
entries.example: He's known to be like that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 众所周知，他就是这样的。

entries.definition: [Calculation] large, large-scale
entries.definitionTranslation: [计] 大型的, 大规模的
entries.example: They were thinking on a large scale.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们的思考范围很大。

entries.definition: last night
entries.example: What did he say last night?
entries.exampleTranslation: 他昨晚说了什么？

entries.definition: to arrange something according to a detailed plan, for example rooms in a building, roads in a town, or areas on a piece of land
entries.definitionTranslation:
摆开, 展示, 布置, 安排, 投资
[经] 花钱, 投资, 布局
entries.example: The countries laid out plans for a peace agreement.
entries.exampleTranslation: 各国制定了和平协议的计划。

entries.definition: to begin a process that causes something to happen
entries.example: Excessive smoking can lead to heart disease.
entries.exampleTranslation: 过度吸烟会导致心脏病。

entries.definition: guided, influenced, or directed by
entries.example: He was led by his competitive drive above all.
entries.exampleTranslation: 最重要的是，他的竞争动力引领着他。

entries.definition: in spite of
entries.example: I can't run let alone walk.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我连跑都跑不了，更不用说走路了。

entries.definition: restricted to a particular group, amount, or area
entries.example: The dinner was limited to seniors.
entries.exampleTranslation: 晚餐仅限老年人参加。

entries.definition: No difference [same] as...
entries.example: It's little more than pageantry if you ask me.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果你问我的话，这只不过是一场盛会。

entries.definition: a long time ago
entries.example: I gave up on that idea long ago.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我很久以前就放弃了这个想法。

entries.definition: long ago
entries.example: Long before I could quit I was offered a promotion.
entries.exampleTranslation: 早在我辞职之前，我就获得了晋升。

entries.definition: long term
entries.example: It seems to work, but what of the long term effects?
entries.exampleTranslation: 这似乎有效，但长期效果如何？

entries.definition: to be responsible for something
entries.definitionTranslation: 目送, 照顾, 关心
entries.example: She did more than just look after the finances.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她所做的不仅仅是管理财务。

entries.definition: behaving in a way that is likely to get you involved in an argument or fight
entries.example: Bargains can be found if you know what to look for.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果您知道要寻找什么，就可以找到便宜货。

entries.definition: to feel happy and excited about something that is going to happen
entries.definitionTranslation: 期望, 盼望; 瞩望; 属望; 企
entries.example: It's something we can all look forward to.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是我们大家都可以期待的事情。

entries.definition: Look like (someone or something) [similar]; likely to appear [cause] (something, do something); 伣; similar
entries.definitionTranslation: 看起来与（某人或某物）相像[相似]; 很可能出现[引起]（某事、做某事）; 伣; 似
entries.example: It's not what it looks like.
entries.exampleTranslation: 事情不是看上去的那样。

entries.definition: to direct your thoughts or attention to something
entries.definitionTranslation: 照看, 注意, 指望
entries.example: He constantly looked to us for advice and support.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他不断向我们寻求建议和支持。

entries.definition: A lot of..., a lot of...
entries.example: Lots of them do travel during the winter months.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们中的许多人在冬季旅行。

entries.definition: to move or progress toward a place or result
entries.example: The mouse made its way across the field.
entries.exampleTranslation: 老鼠穿过了田野。

entries.definition: advance, march, succeed, prosper
entries.definitionTranslation: 前进, 行进, 成功, 发迹
entries.example: The mouse made its way across the field.
entries.exampleTranslation: 老鼠穿过了田野。

entries.definition: to cause people to have a particular false opinion about someone or something
entries.definitionTranslation:
书写, 填写, 拼凑, 说明, 理解, 辨认出, 设法应付, 进展
[法] 开出, 写出, 看出
entries.example: He could barely make out her signature.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他几乎看不清她的签名。

entries.definition: meaningful
entries.example: Doesn't it make sense to do it that way?
entries.exampleTranslation: 这样做不是很有意义吗？

entries.definition: Sure
entries.example: I had to make sure before I opened the door.
entries.exampleTranslation: 开门前我必须确认一下。

entries.definition: to become friendly with someone again after an argument
entries.definitionTranslation:
弥补, 赔偿, 配制, 包装, 编辑, 虚构, 缝制, 组成, 和解, 结算, 整理, 化装
[经] 弥补, 赔偿, 内部运装
entries.example: Hispanics make up a large part of the population.
entries.exampleTranslation: 西班牙裔占人口的很大一部分。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) To decide; to reach a conclusion.
entries.definitionTranslation: 下决心, 接受, 承认
entries.example: You'd better make up your mind.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你最好拿定主意。

entries.definition: use
entries.example: We made use of the stopover.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们利用了中途停留的机会。

entries.definition: achieve, try
entries.example: Did you manage to get in touch at all?
entries.exampleTranslation: 您成功取得联系了吗？

entries.definition: There is a good reason, it is possible; it might as well
entries.definitionTranslation: 很有理由,大有可能;不妨
entries.example: He hasn't yet but may well try before long.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他还没有，但不久之后可能会尝试。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) supposed to, obliged to, ought to
entries.example: I haven't seen it but it's meant to be his best so far.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我还没看过，但这应该是他迄今为止最好的。

entries.definition: It's better to..., might as well
entries.example: We're here now so we might as well.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们现在就在这里，所以我们也可以。

entries.definition: note, pay attention, remember
entries.definitionTranslation: 注意, 留心, 记住
entries.example: Mind you, that's one reason why I go there.
entries.exampleTranslation: 请注意，这就是我去那里的原因之一。

entries.definition: (degree) Progressively more.
entries.example: More and more it's about the customer.
entries.exampleTranslation: 越来越多地以客户为中心。

entries.definition: Approximately.
entries.example: It's more or less what we imagined I suppose.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我想这或多或少是我们想象的。

entries.definition: Contextual comparative. Modifies another adjective (to which the "so" is a direct anaphoric reference), indicating a greater degree of the quality in question.
entries.definitionTranslation: 语境比较。修饰另一个形容词（“so”是直接指代），表明所讨论的质量更高程度。
entries.example: Boston is walkable, and San Francisco more so.
entries.exampleTranslation: 波士顿适合步行，旧金山更适合步行。

entries.definition: a. Possible, promising (superlative of likely); suitable; unable to keep; for sure
entries.definitionTranslation: a. 可能的, 有希望的( likely的最高级 ); 适合的; 保不住; 谅必
entries.example: It is most likely the reason for the warming.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这很可能是变暖的原因。

entries.definition: to change your ideas, attitudes, behaviour etc
entries.example: I'd like to move on if I may.
entries.exampleTranslation: 如果可以的话，我想继续前进。

entries.definition: (hortative) It is not important; do not fret; used to reassure or comfort the person to whom it is said.
entries.example: Never mind that it's my birthday today.
entries.exampleTranslation: 别介意今天是我的生日。

entries.definition: In an adjacent building, room or place.
entries.example: The people next door didn't seem to mind.
entries.exampleTranslation: 隔壁的人似乎并不介意。

entries.definition: almost
entries.example: Next to his sister, he was the best looking of them.
entries.exampleTranslation: 除了他的妹妹，他是他们中最好看的。

entries.definition: without a doubt; surely.
entries.example: She can and will no doubt improve over time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 随着时间的推移，她可以而且毫无疑问会有所进步。

entries.definition: Useless, useless, useless
entries.example: It's no good sitting there you have to type.
entries.exampleTranslation: 坐在那里打字是没有好处的。

entries.definition: (emphatic) I don't know.
entries.example: You have no idea.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你不知道。

entries.definition: no longer
entries.example: Fortunately, it is no longer a concern now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 幸运的是，现在不再是一个问题了。

entries.definition: (dated or US) It doesn't matter, it's unimportant, it doesn't make any difference.
entries.example: No matter what they say, it's down to you now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不管他们怎么说，现在取决于你了。

entries.definition: at most
entries.example: No more than five of them had auto insurance.
entries.exampleTranslation: 其中不超过五人拥有汽车保险。

entries.definition: n. no one
entries.example: I will speak to no one about this.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不会向任何人谈论此事。

entries.definition: no evidence that someone or something is present
entries.example: Still no sign of him?
entries.exampleTranslation: 还是没有他的踪影？

entries.definition: There is no such thing
entries.example: He said no such thing.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他说没有这样的事。

entries.definition: Alternative form of small wonder.
entries.example: No wonder he's ranked first.
entries.exampleTranslation: 难怪他排名第一。

entries.definition: used to emphasize that the least expected thing is not true
entries.example: No one cared, not even when they saw the photos.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有人在意，即使他们看到这些照片也没有在意。

entries.definition: Not only, not only, not only; not only; not only; more than
entries.definitionTranslation: 不但, 不仅, 不只; 非但; 不独; 何止
entries.example: Not only was it cheap, it was delicious.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它不仅便宜，而且很好吃。

entries.definition: Only
entries.example: I have nothing but respect for her.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我除了尊重她什么都没有。

entries.definition: certainly
entries.example: He said he'd come of course.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他说他当然会来。

entries.definition: having only a small amount, value, or importance
entries.example: It was of little relevance, really.
entries.exampleTranslation: 事实上，这没什么相关性。

entries.definition: An expression of dismay, concern, worry or disapproval.
entries.definitionTranslation: 表达沮丧、关心、担心或不赞成。
entries.example: He didn't? Oh dear.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他没有？哦亲爱的。

entries.definition: An exclamation or expression of alarm about a problem or error.
entries.definitionTranslation: 对问题或错误的感叹或表达警报。
entries.example: Oh no not again.
entries.exampleTranslation: 哦，不，不会了。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) An expression of mild disappointment or resignation: too bad; it's a pity; what can you do; it is what it is.
entries.definitionTranslation: （惯用语）表达轻微的失望或无奈：太糟糕了；太糟糕了；真遗憾;你能做什么？就是这样。
entries.example: It was due yesterday? Oh well.
entries.exampleTranslation: 昨天就到期了？那好吧。

entries.definition: Classic cocktail
entries.example: He's just a bit old fashioned sometimes.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他只是有时有点守旧。

entries.definition: Expressed as a measure of central tendency (usually the arithmetic mean).
entries.example: How much does he make on average?
entries.exampleTranslation: 他平均赚多少钱？

entries.definition: Speaking or acting for.
entries.example: I'd like to apologize on behalf of the committee.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我谨代表委员会向您道歉。

entries.definition: On or in (a means of transportation).
entries.definitionTranslation:
在船/车/飞机上, 在公共交通车辆上
[经] 已装船
entries.example: Are you on board with the decision?
entries.exampleTranslation: 您同意这个决定吗？

entries.definition: alone, independently, actively
entries.definitionTranslation: 独自地, 独立地, 主动地
entries.example: You did this on your own?
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是你自己做的吗？

entries.definition: Based on
entries.example: She came on the basis that it would help her.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她来的理由是这会对她有帮助。

entries.definition: for the reason or justification stated
entries.example: The decision was made on the grounds of safety.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该决定是出于安全考虑而做出的。

entries.definition: Offered for sale.
entries.example: How long has it been on the market?
entries.exampleTranslation: 它上市多久了？

entries.definition: on the one hand
entries.example: On the one hand, it's cheap.
entries.exampleTranslation: 一方面，它很便宜。

entries.definition: on the other hand
entries.example: On the other hand, the business did make a profit.
entries.exampleTranslation: 另一方面，企业也确实盈利了。

entries.definition: Synonym of on one's part.
entries.definitionTranslation:
就...而言, 在...一边, 由...表现出来的, 由...所经历的, 由...所作出的
[法] 就...而言
entries.example: There are no barriers on the part of the government.
entries.exampleTranslation: 政府方面不存在任何障碍。

entries.definition: on a journey, in the process of...
entries.definitionTranslation: 在旅途中, 在...过程中
entries.example: I can't wait to get on the road again.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我迫不及待地想再次上路。

entries.definition: On the way, approaching; <口> (child) has been conceived but not yet born; along the way; along the road
entries.definitionTranslation: 在途中, 接近; <口>（孩子）已成胎而尚未出生; 沿途; 沿路
entries.example: We can stop for lunch on the way.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们可以在途中停下来吃午饭。

entries.definition: Generally speaking, basically
entries.example: It was acceptable on the whole.
entries.exampleTranslation: 总体来说还是可以接受的。

entries.definition: again
entries.example: Once again, this was completely unforeseen.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这又是完全出乎意料的。

entries.definition: Again, a further time, once again.
entries.example: I call on you once more my fellow citizens.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我再次向你们呼吁，我的同胞们。

entries.definition: (reciprocal pronoun) Used of a reciprocal relationship among a group of two or more people or things; compare each other.
entries.example: They looked at one another for a few minutes.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们互相看了几分钟。

entries.definition: to oppose; to oppose
entries.example: He's strangely opposed to gun control.
entries.exampleTranslation: 奇怪的是，他反对枪支管制。

entries.definition: or something
entries.example: I don't want any trouble or anything.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不想有任何麻烦或任何事情。

entries.definition: About, maybe,...about
entries.example: A day or so later he called me back on my mobile.
entries.exampleTranslation: 大约一天后，他用手机给我回了电话。

entries.definition: (idiomatic) Or something like that. Used to indicate the possibility that the preceding word or phrase is vague or not exactly correct in its applicability.
entries.example: The sales clerk seemed distracted or something.
entries.exampleTranslation: 售货员似乎心不在焉什么的。

entries.definition: one or a small number more
entries.example: He had a thing or two to drink, then left.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他喝了一两杯，然后就离开了。

entries.definition: or other similar things
entries.example: The challenge or whatever is doing it under budget.
entries.exampleTranslation: 挑战或其他什么是在预算范围内完成的。

entries.definition: different from, except
entries.example: No one other than you could have come up with it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 除了你之外，没有人能想出这个办法。

entries.definition: (auxiliary) Indicating duty or obligation.
entries.example: She hasn't but she ought to.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她没有，但她应该这么做。

entries.definition: outside, leave, from within, out of, due to, because of, lack of, without, give up, lose
entries.definitionTranslation: 在...外, 离开..., 从...里面, 出于, 由于, 因为, 缺乏, 没有, 放弃, 丧失
entries.example: In terms of colour, three out of five were silver.
entries.exampleTranslation: 就颜色而言，五分之三是银色。

entries.definition: (informal) Extreme; radical; far removed from the ordinary; crazy, nutty, loony.
entries.definitionTranslation: （非正式）极端；激进的;远离平凡；疯狂、疯狂、疯狂。
entries.example: There are simply no jobs out there right now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 现在根本就没有工作机会。

entries.definition: in these years, in those years
entries.definitionTranslation: 在这几年中, 在那几年中
entries.example: She has over the years visited many cities.
entries.exampleTranslation: 多年来，她去过许多城市。

entries.definition: In that place; there (at some distance).
entries.example: He put it way over there.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他把它放在那边。

entries.definition: [count] timeout
entries.example: It might change over time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它可能会随着时间的推移而改变。

entries.definition: Because..., because...
entries.example: Owing to his honesty, he was held in high esteem.
entries.exampleTranslation: 由于他的诚实，他受到很高的尊重。

entries.definition: Alternative spelling of part-time.
entries.example: She can take it on part time.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她可以兼职。

entries.definition: if something picks up speed, it starts to move faster
entries.definitionTranslation: 掘地, 捡起, 获得, 学会, 看到, 中途带, 搭乘, 重新找到, 振作, 加快, 好转, 整理
entries.example: She dropped by to pick up her friend.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她顺便去接她的朋友。

entries.definition:
point of view
[Law] argument, opinion, stance
entries.definitionTranslation:
观点
[法] 论点, 见解, 立场
entries.example: They all had a different point of view.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们都有不同的观点。

entries.definition: to show someone who a person is or where something is
entries.example: She pointed out that it was getting late.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她指出时间已经晚了。

entries.definition:
in front, first
[Scripture] before...
entries.definitionTranslation:
在前, 居先
[经] 在...之前
entries.example: Prior to the event, the organizers called the band.
entries.exampleTranslation: 活动开始前，主办方给乐队打了电话。

entries.definition: to be shown eventually to have a particular quality
entries.example: The bicycle proved to be of immense value.
entries.exampleTranslation: 事实证明，这辆自行车具有巨大的价值。

entries.definition: to look after someone by making money in order to buy the things that they need
entries.definitionTranslation: 作准备, 供养, 规定
entries.example: The other variables have been provided for.
entries.exampleTranslation: 已提供其他变量。

entries.definition:
conj. Conditioned on..., if
[French] As long as, but
entries.definitionTranslation:
conj. 以...为条件, 假如
[法] 只要, 但
entries.example: It's OK provided that he come up with the goods.
entries.exampleTranslation: 只要他能拿出货来就可以了。

entries.definition: to change the time of a clock or watch to a later time
entries.definitionTranslation:
放出, 拿出, 提出, 推举出
[法] 放出, 提出
entries.example: The group put forward several other proposals.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该小组还提出了其他几项提案。

entries.definition: speak, say, express, comment
entries.example: There's no better way to put it, I think.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我认为没有更好的方式来表达它。

entries.definition: to choose people or things to form a team or group
entries.definitionTranslation: 把...加起来, 装配, 整理
entries.example: He put together the proposal in a matter of days.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他在几天内就完成了该提案。

entries.definition: same as put forward
entries.definitionTranslation:
举起, 抬起, 进行, 推举, 参加竞选, 提供, 建造, 接待, 包装, 公布, 上演
[化] 搭架
entries.example: The authorities put up a sign to notify the public.
entries.exampleTranslation: 当局张贴了一个标志来通知公众。

entries.definition: a fairly large amount or frequency
entries.example: I do swim quite a lot.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我经常游泳。

entries.definition: Rather than...

entries.exampleTranslation: 与成人相比，儿童往往学得很快。

entries.definition: shown or expressed in something

entries.exampleTranslation: 艺术家的焦虑反映在她的画作中。

entries.definition: depend on, depend on
entries.example: He has no one else to rely on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他没有其他人可以依靠。

entries.definition: to cause something, or to produce something
entries.definitionTranslation:
导致
[法] 产生, 导致
entries.example: Excessive criticism resulted in feelings of animosity.
entries.exampleTranslation: 过多的批评会导致敌意。

entries.definition: remove, get rid of
entries.example: She was happy to be rid of it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她很高兴摆脱了它。

entries.definition: at this moment
entries.example: The best time is right now.
entries.exampleTranslation: 最好的时机就是现在。

entries.definition: to tell someone your ideas so that they can give you their opinion
entries.definitionTranslation: [网络] 运行者；解释给…听；问…意见
entries.example: The operation is run by two college students.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该业务由两名大学生经营。

entries.definition: if a pen runs out, it has no more ink left in it
entries.example: You need to get milk before you run out.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你需要在牛奶用完之前去取牛奶。

entries.definition: reported or generally believed to be

entries.exampleTranslation: 据说牧师失踪了。

entries.definition: to try or aim to do something
entries.example: The new board sought to find alternative solutions.
entries.exampleTranslation: 新董事会寻求寻找替代解决方案。

entries.definition: to cause a situation or a series of events to happen, especially without intending to
entries.definitionTranslation:
出发, 开始, 引起, 衬托, 点缀, 抵销, 分开, 划分
[法] 抵销
entries.example: We set off at noon.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们中午出发。

entries.definition: to explain, describe, or arrange something in a clear and detailed way, especially in writing
entries.definitionTranslation:
出发, 开始, 陈列, 宣布, 陈述, 栽种, 设计...的布局, 测定
[法] 发表, 宣布, 打算
entries.example: She accomplished what she set out to do.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她完成了她打算做的事情。

entries.definition: to start doing something in a determined or enthusiastic way
entries.definitionTranslation: 开始认真干, 开始大吃, 争吵起来
entries.example: He's set to arrive today.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他定于今天到达。

entries.definition: to arrange a situation so that someone is blamed for doing something, especially something illegal
entries.definitionTranslation:
设立
[化] 调定; 装置妥; 装置妥当; 装置; 装备; 建立
entries.example: The whole thing was set up beforehand.
entries.exampleTranslation: 整个事情都是事先安排好的。

entries.definition: to move the head from side to side, often to show no
entries.example: He just shook his head and laughed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他只是摇摇头笑了。

entries.definition: Except; but; without resorting to; up to the point of.
entries.definitionTranslation: 缺乏, 达不到, 除...以外
entries.example: Short of calling the doctor, I don't know what to do.
entries.exampleTranslation: 除了打电话给医生，我不知道该怎么办。

entries.definition: Alternative form of short-term.
entries.example: There are many short term gains to be had.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有许多短期收益可以得到。

entries.definition: demonstrated by evidence to have a quality or effect
entries.example: Dogs have been shown to help.
entries.exampleTranslation: 狗已被证明可以提供帮助。

entries.definition: to close a building so that people cannot enter or leave it
entries.definitionTranslation: 关闭, 监禁, 住口, 保藏
entries.example: I just couldn't shut up.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我就是无法闭嘴。

entries.definition: the act or experience of seeing someone or something
entries.example: I can't stand the sight of it, to tell you the truth.
entries.exampleTranslation: 说实话，我无法忍受看到它。

entries.definition: before an infinitive: in order to; to.
entries.example: He cluttered his desk so as to appear busy.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他把桌子堆得乱七八糟，以显得很忙。

entries.definition: adj. so-called
entries.example: Any so called rumors are as easily their fault.
entries.exampleTranslation: 任何所谓的谣言都很容易是他们的错。

entries.definition: so far
entries.example: Any questions so far?
entries.exampleTranslation: 到目前为止还有什么问题吗？

entries.definition: As far as...; as far as..., within the scope of..., as for...
entries.definitionTranslation: 远至…;就…来说,在…范围内,至于
entries.example: So far as I know it's not the first time either.
entries.exampleTranslation: 据我所知，这也不是第一次了。

entries.definition: so
entries.example: Park it so that the wheels are curbed.
entries.exampleTranslation: 将其停放，以便限制车轮。

entries.definition: a mediocre; a bare minimum; (denoting that something only barely fits a certain category, or is very mediocre in it)
entries.definitionTranslation: 平庸；最低限度； （表示某事物仅勉强适合某个类别，或者非常平庸）
entries.example: What are you, some kind of genius?
entries.exampleTranslation: 你是个什么天才？

entries.definition: More
entries.example: I'll have to think some more before deciding.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在做出决定之前我还得再考虑一下。

entries.definition: an unspecified quality connected with someone or something
entries.example: There's something about her I find interesting.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我觉得她有一些有趣的地方。

entries.definition: somewhat similar, somewhat similar
entries.example: She makes something like five grand a month.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她每个月赚大约五英镑。

entries.definition: something similar to what was just mentioned
entries.example: He said he had a meeting to go to or something like that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他说他要去参加一个会议或者类似的事情。

entries.definition: It smells like..., a bit like...
entries.example: She's something of a mathematics wiz.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她是一位数学奇才。

entries.definition: somewhat
entries.example: It's sort of why I'm here.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这就是我来这里的原因。

entries.definition: to do what is necessary to deal with a problem, disagreement, or difficult situation successfully
entries.example: They managed to sort out everything on their own.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们设法自己解决了一切。

entries.definition: if a letter, an abbreviation, or a symbol stands for something, that is what it means or represents
entries.definitionTranslation:
代表, 代替, 象征, 支持, 担任...的候选人
[法] 代替, 代表, 拥护
entries.example: That symbol used to stand for something.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这个符号曾经代表着某种东西。

entries.definition: (idiomatic, UK, Ireland, Commonwealth) Very soon; quickly; immediately.
entries.example: They'll get to it straight away.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们会立即着手处理。

entries.definition:
to submit to, to suffer
[Scripture] To be verified, limited by, due to
entries.definitionTranslation:
使服从, 使遭受
[经] 有待查实, 受限于, 由于
entries.example: All baggage is subject to inspection.
entries.exampleTranslation: 所有行李均需接受检查。

entries.definition: Such...
entries.example: She had such a strange sense of humor.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她有一种奇怪的幽默感。

entries.definition: For example..., something like this
entries.example: We have questions, such as how it happened.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们有疑问，比如它是如何发生的。

entries.definition: That's it
entries.example: It can be developed such that it does not interfere.
entries.exampleTranslation: 它可以被开发成不干扰。

entries.definition: Guess so
entries.example: I didn't go, but I was supposed to.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我没去，但我应该去。

entries.definition: if you switch on something such as a light or a machine, or if it switches on, you make it start working
entries.example: It's plugged in but it won't switch on.
entries.exampleTranslation: 已插入电源但无法开机。

entries.definition: consider
entries.example: We did not take account of the paperwork.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们没有考虑文书工作。

entries.definition: (intransitive) To profit from a situation deliberately.
entries.example: Some people just want to take advantage.
entries.exampleTranslation: 有些人只是想占便宜。

entries.definition:
take care of
[Law] support, support, support
entries.definitionTranslation:
照顾
[法] 抚养, 赡养, 扶养
entries.example: I'll take care of this customer.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我会照顾这个顾客的。

entries.definition: [French] Take it for granted
entries.example: It's just something I've always taken for granted.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这只是我一直认为理所当然的事情。

entries.definition: pay attention to, consider
entries.example: You must also take into account the rush hour.
entries.exampleTranslation: 您还必须考虑高峰时间。

entries.definition: if an aircraft takes off, it leaves the ground and starts flying
entries.definitionTranslation:
拿掉, 取消, 脱下, 领走, 减去, 复制, 起飞, 离开, 岔开
[经] 取消
entries.example: I was hungry by the time we took off.
entries.exampleTranslation: 起飞时我已经饿了。

entries.definition: to accept some work or responsibility
entries.definitionTranslation: 呈现, 具有, 雇用, 接纳, 承担, 同...较量, 流行, 盛气凌人
entries.example: You'd better think twice before taking on more work.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在承担更多工作之前你最好三思而后行。

entries.definition: to begin to do something that someone else was doing
entries.definitionTranslation:
接收, 接管
[法] 接管, 接受, 让受
entries.example: You can't just let the kids take over.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你不能只让孩子们接管。

entries.definition:
participate, participate
[by] participate in, take part in
entries.definitionTranslation:
参与, 参加
[经] 参加, 参与
entries.example: It's something we all wanted to take part in.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这是我们都想参与的事情。

entries.definition: occur
entries.example: No one was sure exactly why it took place there.
entries.exampleTranslation: 没有人确切知道为什么会发生这样的事。

entries.definition: to accept an offer or a challenge (=an offer to fight or compete) that someone has made to you
entries.definitionTranslation:
拿起, 开始从事, 继续, 接纳, 吸收, 占据, 拘捕, 承兑, 认购, 绷紧
[经] 付清, 承兑(汇票), 认购(债券等)
entries.example: I don't wish to take up more time than is necessary.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不想占用比必要的时间更多的时间。

entries.definition: attention, tendency
entries.example: I tend to think it's actually a political matter.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我倾向于认为这实际上是一个政治问题。

entries.definition: Because of; normally used with a positive connotation, though it can be used sarcastically.
entries.example: And it's thanks to her research that we know that.
entries.exampleTranslation: 正是由于她的研究，我们才知道这一点。

entries.definition: (as an interjection) That is
entries.example: It's yours, as long as you pay that is.
entries.exampleTranslation: 只要你付钱，它就是你的。

entries.definition: So many, those, so many
entries.definitionTranslation: 那样多, 那些, 就那样多
entries.example: I don't go out that much.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我不常出去。

entries.definition: things similar to those just mentioned
entries.example: He drinks a lot and that sort of thing.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他喝了很多酒之类的。

entries.definition: the thing or things that
entries.example: You cannot undo that which has already been done.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你无法撤消已经完成的事情。

entries.definition: That's all (there is nothing more to the issue).
entries.definitionTranslation: 仅此而已（没有更多的问题了）。
entries.example: That's it for today, I'm afraid.
entries.exampleTranslation: 恐怕今天就这样了。

entries.definition: above mentioned
entries.example: The above only underscores strength of the data.
entries.exampleTranslation: 以上仅强调了数据的强度。

entries.definition: Most of it, most of it, most of it
entries.example: The bulk of it was done by noon.
entries.exampleTranslation: 大部分工作在中午之前就完成了。

entries.definition: the true situation or set of facts
entries.example: It's not the case that I don't love him.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我并不是不爱他。

entries.definition: the degree to which something is true or happens
entries.example: The extent to which the preceding can be asserted is largely dependent on what emerges in the study.
entries.exampleTranslation: 前述内容的成立程度很大程度上取决于研究中出现的情况。

entries.definition: the person or thing mentioned next
entries.example: He made the following remarks.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他发表以下言论。

entries.definition: former
entries.example: The former can actually require much more money.
entries.exampleTranslation: 前者实际上可能需要更多的钱。

entries.definition: the latter
entries.example: The latter may still be a challenge.
entries.exampleTranslation: 后者可能仍然是一个挑战。

entries.definition: all, all
entries.example: They tood the jewellery, the laptops, the lot.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们拿走了珠宝、笔记本电脑等等。

entries.definition: the money, resources, or ability needed for something
entries.example: He hasn't the means to get there.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他没有办法到达那里。

entries.definition: an occasional one

entries.exampleTranslation: 我确实演奏奇怪的爵士乐曲调。

entries.definition: one day not long ago

entries.exampleTranslation: 那天我想起了你。

entries.definition: the experience of seeing someone or something
entries.example: I can't stand the sight of it.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我无法忍受看到它。

entries.definition: all of a situation, event, or object
